source_selection: Same final shared hybrid development checkpoint as the fixed-budget actor-only ablation. Pair the actor, native training state and auxiliary sidecar by step and checkpoint-set ID. Reject prior or best-scoring alternatives.
transfer: Extract only shared dynamics weights plus the original input and output centers and scales. Both source normalizations remain fixed throughout target adaptation. Transfer the same actor and its batch statistics; leave native critic, replay, optimizer, target transition history and auxiliary optimizer fresh. Per-target sampling, Adam and model update counters begin at zero.
target_exposures: Same references, source-stage masks, world count, four native step budgets, seeds, physical settings, curriculum and auxiliary update schedule as the actor-only fresh-world-model arm. Resume only each target's own correctly paired native and auxiliary state. No target state is reused across participants.
zero_shot: Reuse the exact existing zero-shot report for the same actor, reference, source-stage hash and physical certificates. The transferred world model only participates in target training, so there is no second zero-shot experiment.
accounting: Report time-to-verified pass and matched-step trajectories side by side. Charge shared hybrid pretraining once per stand-alone deployment in each counterfactual method's totals. Across the experiment charge prep, calibration, shared pretraining and zero-shot scoring only once, and report the extra CPU export plus actual target adaptation/scoring costs separately.
regime: Register rule and extraction hashes against the final development selection before any held-out source is opened. Execute separately after the original comparison is complete. The signed primary and supplementary split and v1 ablation remain authoritative.
